summary: PO three-way match failure: missing GRN and ambiguous GL code blocking Nexera Labs payment
description: Issue summary: Invoice INV-2026-874 (Nexera Labs) is blocked by the AP system due to a failed three-way match against PO PO-78421. The AP workflow reports two separate failures: (1) no Goods Receipt Note (GRN) exists for the service lines and (2) the invoice's GL/cost center mapping did not match ERP mapping rules (ambiguous code 'SD-UK-23'). Impact: Vendor is unpaid and has escalated to CS; potential interruption of scheduled integration work next week. Business impact: estimated vendor throughput impact if payment delayed beyond next Thursday. Systems involved: AP platform (NetSuite integration), Procurement portal, Vendor invoice ingestion (OCR pipeline).
steps_to_reproduce: 2) Search for invoice number INV-2026-874 or PO PO-78421
3) Open invoice header -> view 'Match status' -> observe 'Three-way match exception'
4) Click into match details to see missing GRN and mapping error code TW-MATCH-001
5) Check PO PO-78421 in Procurement portal -> compare line items and unit prices
logs: AP error: TW-MATCH-001; ERP sync job net-sync-2026-03-12-22:14 returned mapping warnings for cost_center 'SD-UK-23' -> no match in cost_center_table. OCR pipeline job ocr-invoice-2026-03-12-03 produced line merge alert (invoice_line_3 merged with line_4). SFTP drop: /incoming/vendors/nexera/INV-2026-874.pdf
comments: Miguel Torres (reporter) 2026-03-13: Vendor called support; they say services performed March 3-5. Need payment scheduled for 03/20 payroll cycle. Blocking error shows 'missing GRN'.
AP Analyst - Ravi Shah 2026-03-13: System flagged three-way match failure. PO unit price differs from invoice line; no GRN for a service PO. Marked for manual review. Error TW-MATCH-001.

Procurement - Lila Nguyen 2026-03-13: Confirmed PO PO-78421 was created for 'Nexera Platform Integration' under cost center SD-UK-23. Procurement didn't receive a service completion confirmation; vendor submitted invoice referencing SOW-77. We're checking if service was logged under a different PO by the engagement manager.
Vendor - Nexera AP contact (email) 2026-03-13: Provided signed SOW and timesheets attached. Requesting confirmation of receipt and expected payment date.

Sana Kapoor (assignee) 2026-03-14: Starting manual reconciliation. Requesting AP to create GRN stub if Procurement confirms delivery. Will also attempt manual GL override for this cycle pending approvals.
investigation_notes: Checked Procurement: PO exists and unit price on PO is 12,500 GBP per milestone; invoice shows 15,000 GBP for same milestone (price variance 20%).
No GRN record in AP for PO-78421. Procurement indicates engagement manager may have used ad-hoc PO PO-78910 for a change order; need cross-check.

OCR evidence: invoice lines 2/3 were merged causing quantity/price mismatch; original PDF from vendor (SFTP) shows two distinct lines. OCR pipeline needs a manual override option for vendors with frequent line merges.

ERP mapping: cost center 'SD-UK-23' not present in the cost_center_table used by net-sync job; this caused mapping failure and prevented GL assignment. This cost center was recently added in Procurement sheet but not pushed to NetSuite (suspected deployment drift).

Hypotheses: (A) Vendor invoiced updated amount for an approved change order that was not reflected on PO; (B) Invoice ingestion corrupted line items causing mismatch; (C) NetSuite mapping gap prevented GL assignment so even if price reconciled, system left invoice blocked.
Urgent: vendor escalation requires payment by 2026-03-20 to avoid contract penalty.
resolution_notes: 2026-03-14: Temporary manual resolution path approved by AP Manager (Yvonne Clarke): create GRN stub referencing vendor SOW and attach timesheets provided by vendor.
2026-03-14: Procurement to raise PO change order PO-78421-CO1 to reflect approved price 15,000 GBP and link to original PO. Change order created by Lila Nguyen: PO-78421-CO1.

2026-03-14: ERP team (net-sync) will import missing cost center 'SD-UK-23' configuration; expected sync completion 2026-03-15 02:00 UTC. Temporary GL override applied for this invoice to enable payment once change order and GRN stub are attached.
Payment plan: AP to schedule payment in next cycle (2026-03-20) pending final approval. Invoice will be unblocked after manual match and manager sign-off.

Follow-up actions: (1) Add OCR review flag for vendor 'Nexera Labs' to bypass auto-merge for 90 days. (2) Procurement and ERP to implement a weekly reconciliation job to detect drift between Procurement cost center sheet and NetSuite mapping. Owner: Lila Nguyen and Omar Patel. Deadline: 2026-03-22.
Postmortem: Create short runbook for manual three-way override and define SLA for vendor escalations (>P1) to avoid repeat. Owner: AP Ops (Yvonne). Due: 2026-03-28.
